failedCase: A11yRenderSuite.compare-t3, dark: every Tab stop is drawn differently when focused
cause: The CSS-only audit could run after report rows arrived but before VirtualFlow layout realized their cursor graphic. It compared two unrealized states, so no row focus border could differ.
fix: Apply CSS and complete layout before inspecting focusable nodes. Production focus styling and behavior are unchanged.
regression: Create a fresh served ParticipantsNavigatorView in the live dock; assert no cursor graphic exists before audit, require an empty unmarked result and a realized cursor afterward. Removing layout deterministically fails exactly this case.

mutation.case: the focus audit realizes newly served virtual participant rows
